Interface Entity.Snapshot

DataHolder<Entity.Snapshot>, DataHolder.Mutable<Entity.Snapshot>, Entity<Entity.Snapshot>, Entity.Target<Entity.Snapshot>, Locatable
Enclosing interface:
Entity<Self extends Entity<Self>>
public static interface Entity.Snapshot extends Entity.Target<Entity.Snapshot>
An entity that holds all the data of the entity (except the network id as there is no need for it), but has not been spawned within the world
